questionText: A direct mapped cache memory of $1\text{ MB}$ has a block size of $256\text{ bytes}$. The cache has an access time of $3\text{ ns}$ and a hit rate of $94\%$. During a cache miss, it takes $20\text{ ns}$ to bring the first word of a block from the main memory, while each subsequent word takes $5\text{ ns}$. The word size is $64\text{ bits}$. The average memory access time in $\text{ns}$ (round off to $1$ decimal place) is ________.
explanation:
Step 1: Given Data
Cache Hit Rate ($H$) = $94\% = 0.94$
Cache Miss Rate ($M$) = $1 - 0.94 = 0.06$
Cache Access Time ($T_c$) = $3\text{ ns}$
Block Size = $256\text{ bytes}$
Word Size = $64\text{ bits} = 8\text{ bytes}$

Step 2: Calculate Number of Words per Block
$\text{Number of words per block} = \frac{256\text{ bytes}}{8\text{ bytes}} = 32\text{ words}$

Step 3: Calculate Miss Penalty ($T_{miss}$)
Time for $1^{\text{st}}$ word = $20\text{ ns}$
Time for remaining $31$ words = $31 \times 5\text{ ns} = 155\text{ ns}$
Total Miss Penalty ($T_{miss}$) = $20 + 155 = 175\text{ ns}$

Step 4: Calculate Average Memory Access Time ($T_{avg}$)
$T_{avg} = T_c + (1 - H) \times T_{miss}$
$T_{avg} = 3 + (0.06 \times 175)$
$T_{avg} = 3 + 10.5 = 13.5\text{ ns}$
